about: Games with documented shader-compilation stutter. Only entries with a real source: an https link, or "SCSKiller measurement" for SCSKiller's own. ids are Game.Id values (steam:<appid>, xbox:<package family>, epic:<app name>, ea:<content id>); name is the fallback, compared letters and digits only, case-insensitive. date = when the entry was last checked. Embedded in the app and served at /v1/content/known-stutter.json, the same file; the app uses the served copy when it passes StutterList.TryParse.
